tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The one warm background on every screen, Add included. No hero, no dark areas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, category pills, round buttons and the tab bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, amounts and text on primary. 15.4 to 1 on bg, 9.2 on primary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Dates, labels like Spent, the target amount, inactive month arrows. 5.3 to 1 on bg, 5.6 on surface.

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: A month arrow that cannot be used yet. Graphic only, never text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Golden yellow fill for the one main action, Add spending and Save, and this month's bar. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: gold-line
tokens.usage: Thin progress fills, the target bar and category bars, and the ring on a selected category. Graphic only.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: The only gold for text. Spending less, streaks, links, the selected tab. 6.6 to 1 on bg, 6.3 on soft.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Soft gold fill behind the selected tab and the selected category. Text on it uses gold-text.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of thin bars and past months in the Compare chart.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Spending more than before, going over target, delete. 5.8 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Behind delete confirm buttons and an over target note.

styles.name: amount-entry
styles.usage: The amount you type in Add. Tabular numbers.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: What you spent this month on Month.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles. Month has none, its date row leads instead.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Full width buttons and section labels like Since October.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The word above a big number.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Category names and amounts in cards.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: €96 less than this time in October
styles.usage: The change line, dates, Today, Add a note. 500 when it is a change or a streak.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Target line, category pills, chart month labels.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab labels. 500 on the selected tab.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a big number and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between category pills, and between a row's name and its bar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between the main button and the tab bar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between blocks on a screen.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Side padding inside cards.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side and bottom margin on every screen.

tokens.name: top
tokens.usage: From the top edge to the first row, clearing the status bar.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, the tab bar, thin bars and chart bars.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: The tab bar only. Nothing else has a shadow.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of Add spending and Save.

tokens.name: size-nav
tokens.usage: Height of the tab bar.

tokens.name: size-tab
tokens.usage: One tab inside the bar, 100 wide.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: A category row on Month. Rows on Compare are 50.

tokens.name: size-pill
tokens.usage: A category pill in Add.

tokens.name: size-round
tokens.usage: Round buttons like close, and the smallest tap target.

tokens.name: size-line
tokens.usage: Thickness of the target bar and category bars.
